verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms a structured llms.txt at help.thoropass.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200, markdown index of help articles). Help-center articles are also served as .md endpoints, including the MCP connection guide, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs directly. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation describing or promoting the llms.txt/agent-docs offering, no evidence of an llms-full.txt or developer/API-oriented agent docs beyond the help center, and no independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming it.
